title: Engulfing candle
description: The body of the evaluated bar spans the body of the prior bar in the opposite direction, by at least body_engulf_ratio_min of the prior body length. The prior bar must itself have a body of at least prior_body_to_range_ratio_min of its range, and the two bars must close in opposite directions.
thesis: One bar reversing the entire body of the preceding opposite bar means the prior period's participants are underwater in a single session, which is the measurable form of a completed shift in short-horizon control.

required_hermes_fields.purpose: Open of the evaluated bar and of the prior bar.
Close of the evaluated bar and of the prior bar.
High of both bars, used when require_full_range_engulf is true.
Low of both bars, used when require_full_range_engulf is true.

parameters.name: body_engulf_ratio_min
parameters.description: Minimum body length of the evaluated bar divided by the body length of the prior bar. A value of 1.0 requires the evaluated body to span the prior body exactly; values above 1.0 require it to exceed the prior body.

parameters.name: prior_body_to_range_ratio_min
parameters.description: Minimum body length of the prior bar divided by that bar's total range. Bounding it excludes engulfing a prior bar whose body was too short to represent a position worth reversing.

parameters.name: require_full_range_engulf
parameters.description: When true the evaluated bar's high and low must also span the prior bar's high and low, not only its body.

direction_semantics.direction_rule: LONG when the prior bar closed below its open and the evaluated bar closes above its open while spanning the prior body; SHORT when the prior bar closed above its open and the evaluated bar closes below its open while spanning the prior body.

fields.name: matched
fields.description: True when every declared engulfing condition holds on the evaluated bar.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: LONG for a bullish engulfing bar, SHORT for a bearish one.

fields.name: engulf_ratio
fields.description: Evaluated body length divided by prior body length.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Each engulfing condition, its threshold and whether it held.

deterministic_test_cases.description: Prior bar body 4.0 down from 2005.0 to 2001.0; evaluated bar body 6.0 up from 2000.5 to 2006.5, spanning it. Engulf ratio 1.5.
Prior bar body 4.0 up from 2001.0 to 2005.0; evaluated bar body 6.0 down from 2006.5 to 2000.5, spanning it.
Evaluated body 2.0 against a prior body of 4.0, an engulf ratio of 0.5 which fails the 1.0 threshold.
Both bars close above their opens, so no reversal of control occurs whatever the length of the second body.

provenance.source_reference: PID.md line 55 — engulfing, named as a canonical atomic strategy for HSA v1.
provenance.notes: Architect-set defaults. Body engulfment rather than full-range engulfment is the default reading; the full-range variant is exposed as require_full_range_engulf so the choice is recorded in the specification instead of being assumed by the implementer.
